name: South Korea
dossier:
The South Korea national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Taegeuk Warriors, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 25 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from AFC to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Forever romantics after 2002, Korea travel with Son's farewell-tour energy and a fearless press.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, South Korea will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group A and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group A. The connection between Son Heung-min and Lee Kang-in is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Son Heung-min - the clinical forward who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: South Korea are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Son Heung-min is chasing the one trophy that has eluded a glittering Premier League career.
South Korea boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Fourth place (2002).
